long_biography.plain_text:
Crazy Daisy grew from a single Vejle bar into Denmark's largest nightclub chain after Carsten Mikkelsen co-founded it with Claus Krøyer. He had already opened five clothing shops and developed a network of tanning salons. The nightlife group expanded quickly, and its venues became a meeting point for entrepreneurs who would later build other Danish consumer businesses.

Jesper Buch met Mikkelsen while working at Crazy Daisy and brought him the idea that became Just Eat. Mikkelsen supplied early capital and remained a shareholder and mentor through the delivery platform's difficult first years. He later backed the young founders of Miinto, helping the fashion marketplace obtain experienced management and expansion funding, and joined Gitte Mia Salling in creating the fitness chain Energii. Energii subsequently expanded from its first ten reformer machines into a Nordic studio chain.

Seedster directly states that he lives in Ibiza, while Spain's official commercial gazette records the exact name in an Ibiza company. The saved Spanish residence is retained without proposing a more granular location field.

Hospitality is the strongest creation-sector classification because Mikkelsen co-founded and scaled Crazy Daisy into Denmark's largest nightclub chain before his documented angel-investing career. Public evidence does not disclose the relative lifetime proceeds from Crazy Daisy, Just Eat, Miinto and later holdings, so the classification is scored at 92 rather than presented as an audited allocation of wealth.

A.C.C. Invest is a wholly owned, active investment company with substantial current assets and continuing portfolio holdings, directly supporting Finance & Investments and Investor. Founder remains historically important through Crazy Daisy, while his current Energii board seat and minority holding do not displace the investment-platform relationship.

Broad Self-made rests on positive evidence that Mikkelsen personally co-founded and expanded Crazy Daisy and then supplied his own capital and mentorship to later ventures. No inherited core asset or family succession is evidenced. The sources do not establish his family resources or financial starting platform well enough to distinguish Self-made — independent start from Self-made — advantaged start, so neither narrower subtype is forced.

No reviewed source established a second nationality, exact birth day or place of birth above the import threshold. The existing March 1962 birth data, Danish nationality and Spanish residence are left unchanged rather than expanded from weak biographical listings.

The mandatory Forbes-first audit found no dedicated profile. Search results exposed several common-name LinkedIn and Instagram accounts, including more than one account using the Stokholm name, but no direct official cross-link resolved a personal account above the identity threshold. Energii's official history is proposed as a Company Website because it is independently tied to his exact current ownership and board relationship.

Angel investor is the minimum useful active tag because repeated early-stage capital and mentoring are defining and continue through A.C.C. Invest. No active nightclub-operations concept exists, so Crazy Daisy remains in biography and wealth evidence rather than becoming an invented tag. Venture capital was omitted because the evidence supports personal angel investing, not operation of a venture-capital institution.

The existing biography centres a current vessel, another business partner and time-sensitive ownership claims; the replacement removes all of them. Neither biography includes yacht facts, annual holding values, volatile ownership percentages or unverified social-media claims, and nothing was applied to the source record.
